summary:
Add 17 API boundary node(s)

Motivation: This proposal represents a significant step towards the new boundary node architecture. It proposes deploying 17 additional API boundary nodes, increasing the total number to 20. The selected nodes meet specific criteria: each node has an IPv4 address, a domain name, and is currently unassigned. Additionally, this proposal aims to achieve parity in the number of API boundary nodes and traditional boundary nodes and maintains a similar geographical distribution.
